text:
Alex (Partnerships): FYI — ACMECloud just told us they are changing their usage export to roll at UTC 00:00 and will start reporting amounts in EUR instead of USD next week. We need a quick plan for rounding + timezone crossover impact on partner credits. @Sam - Billing can you weigh in? :eyes:

Sam - Billing: Thanks Alex. Two quick Qs: 1) Do they switch currency on the entire file or per-line? 2) Are their hourly batches still aligned to our existing hourly windows or will some events now land in a different day for the partner?

Alex (Partnerships): They said per-file currency header (so all lines will be EUR). Hourly batches will still be hourly but window alignment is UTC not PST so some customers will move days for our billing cutover. Link to partner note: https://acmecloud.example/usage-cutover (internal).

Maria P: For reconciliation my vote is: normalize everything to UTC day in the ledger, persist raw_partner_currency + partner_amount and store exchange_rate_at_ingest. Do not pre-round until final invoice aggregation. That minimizes drift in downstream rollups.

Jon (Eng): Agree with Maria. Implementation note: we can add two columns to ingestion table: partner_currency_code and partner_amount_minor_units (int). Also add ingest_rate (decimal) and a bool flag currency_mismatch. Pseudocode for conversion: ```converted_minor = round(partner_amount_minor_units * ingest_rate)``` We'll need to decide banker's rounding vs away-from-zero.

Sam - Billing: We prefer "round half away from zero" to avoid systemic negative bias on small customers. Also need policy for credits when UTC cutover shifts usage across billing days — suggest "assign by event timestamp normalized to UTC day" and a reconciliation window of 72 hours for delayed corrections.

Nina (SI): From the SI integration side, partners will need a migration sandbox. We should provide a test file with: old format (USD PST) and new format (EUR UTC) and a small set of edge rows (midnight boundary, 23:59:59 in PST -> 00:59:59 UTC). I'll draft that test vector.

Alex (Partnerships): Good. Can someone own a short runbook for how this affects partner entitlement mapping? We don't want customers losing reserved capacity because of a timezone shift.

Maria P: I'll own entitlement mapping updates. Plan: entitlements continue to be keyed by customer_id + UTC_day. If we detect a large delta (>5% of daily usage change) during first 7 days, trigger a canary rollback and notify Partner Ops.

Jon (Eng): I'll scope the schema changes and a migration plan. ETA for a PR with DB migration + feature flag: EOD tomorrow. I'll include a toggle to keep legacy-day-mode for any partner that requests it.

Sam - Billing: I'll update billing playbook with rounding policy, 72-hour reconciliation SLA, and sample journal entries for EUR -> USD conversion.

saturn-billing-bot: Reminder: scheduled ingest job for ACMECloud changed timezone metadata on 2026-04-02T00:00:00Z. Monitor ingest_errors for 48h. :robot_face:

Alex (Partnerships): Thanks team — let's sync in 30m to triage any blockers.
